Alex —

No problem, thanks for the heads up. Friday 11/21 09:30 PT works for our team — I’ve updated the invite and added a short pre-read note in the event.

Quick notes to address your sizing question before the call:
- For mixed model families (7B–70B quantized) we recommend starting with a small number of model-specific pools (e.g., 7B/13B and 70B groups) and an autoscale policy that allows cross-pool bursting for short intervals. The sizing worksheet (attached) has a sample configuration: 10 GPUs for the 7B pool and 20 GPUs for the 70B pool for an initial 100 concurrent target, with headroom for 2x burst.
- Isolation: we support strict pool pinning and network-level VPC controls for PII workloads; we can also provide a per-tenant KMS separation for keys.
- Autoscaling: combination of predictive pre-warm windows (based on cron/expected traffic) + reactive scale based on queue length and token throughput; cold-start is mitigated via pre-warmed workers and a short fast-path for small requests.

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-proposal-v1.pdf (proposal + config), dedicated-gpu-sizing.pdf (sizing worksheet)

Looking forward to the session — will hand over to Dylan and Dev to run the technical portion.

Best,
